title: NF Research Tools - Organoid Protocol
description: Advanced 3D cellular models including organoids, assembloids, spheroids, and other 3D culture systems.

aiSummary.description: A large language model-generated summary of the resource.

cellTypes.description: Cell types present in the model.

characterizationMethods.description: Methods used to characterize the model.

cultureMedia.description: Growth media used to culture this model (e.g. DMEM, RPMI 1640, mTeSR1), including any supplements.

dateAdded.description: The date that the resource was originally added.

dateModified.description: The last update of the resource metadata.

derivationSource.description: Source of cells used to generate the model.

description.description: Free text description, summary, or purpose of the resource.

geneticDisorder.description: Genetic disorders associated with the resource.

howToAcquire.description: How to acquire a particular resource.

mechanismOfActionValidation.description: Drug mechanisms of action that have been successfully tested in this model.

modelLimitations.description: Explicit description of what this model does NOT recapitulate or where it may produce misleading results.

mtaRequired.description: Whether a Material Transfer Agreement is required to access this model.

nfManifestation.description: NF manifestation this model is used to study.

ngnriRepositoryStatus.description: Whether this model is deposited in the Nick Gilbert Neurofibromatosis Research Institute (NGNRI) repository for equitable access.

organoidType.description: Specific type of organoid, if applicable.

pediatricSuitability.description: Whether this model is derived from or suitable for studying pediatric, adult, or both age groups.

pkpdCapabilities.description: Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic measurements that can be performed in this model.

regulatoryAcceptanceHistory.description: Known FDA/EMA precedents where data from this model type supported a regulatory submission or approval.

resourceId.description: A unique identifier for the resource.

resourceName.description: The canonical name of the resource.

routeOfAdministration.description: Drug delivery routes that have been validated or are feasible in this model.

rrid.description: The RRID, a standard resource identifier for interoperability with other databases. Must include the lowercase 'rrid:' prefix.

suitableForRegulatoryPackage.description: Whether this model has been accepted or is considered sufficient as standalone (non-animal) evidence in a regulatory submission (e.g., for repurposed drugs).

timelineToResults.description: Estimated time from model establishment to primary endpoint readout.
